# Model Fitting Setup Validation

Make the estimand and fitted data explicit before comparing or accepting
models.

## Setup

Resolve the applicable choices:

- requested output: prediction, optimum location, response at the optimum,
  model metric, coefficient, p-value, class, or another quantity;
- response and predictor definitions, units, transformations, and category or
  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;
- candidate models, formulas, fixed parameters, and fitting implementation;
- comparison metric and convention

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', check.names=FALSE)
ratio_p <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), ':', fixed=TRUE), function(z) as.numeric(z[1])/sum(as.numeric(z)), numeric(1))
mix <- subset(d, StrainNumber == '287_98')
mix"'$p287 <- ratio_p(mix$Ratio)
ends <- subset(d, StrainNumber %in% c('"'98','287'))
ends"'$p287 <- ifelse(ends$StrainNumber == '"'287', 1, 0)
sets <- list(interior=mix, complete=rbind(ends, mix))
for (nm in names(sets)) {
  z <- sets[[nm]]
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287"'^2), data=z),
    cubic=lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287''^2) + I(p287''^3), data=z),
    ns4=lm(Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df=4), data=z)
  )
  cat('"'\\nSCOPE',nm,'n=',nrow(z),'range=',paste(range(z"'$p287),collapse='"'..'),'\\n')
  for (fn in names(fits)) {
    f <- fits[[fn]]
    opt <- optimize(function(p) -predict(f,newdata=data.frame(p287=p)), interval=range(z"'$p287), tol=.Machine$double.eps''^.5)
    cat(fn, '"'df=', attr(logLik(f),'df'), 'AIC=',AIC(f),'adjR2=',summary(f)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'optp=',opt"'$minimum,'"'predmax=',-opt"'$objective,'"'\\n')
  }
}

# aggregated frequency means (for sensitivity only)
for (nm in names(sets)) {
 z <- aggregate(Area~p287, sets[[nm]], mean)
 fits <- list(quadratic=lm(Area~p287+I(p287"'^2),z),cubic=lm(Area~p287+I(p287''^2)+I(p287''^3),z),ns4=lm(Area~splines::ns(p287,df=4),z))
 cat('"'\\nAGG',nm,'n=',nrow(z),'\\n')
 for(fn in names(fits)) {
  f<-fits[[fn]]; opt<-optimize(function(p)-predict(f,data.frame(p287=p)),range(z"'$p287),tol=.Machine$double.eps''^.5)
  cat(fn,'"'AIC=',AIC(f),'adjR2=',summary(f)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'optp=',opt"'$minimum,'"'predmax=',-opt"'$objective,'"'\\n')
 }
}
RS"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
z <- d[d"'$StrainNumber == '"'287_98', ]
parts <- strsplit(z"'$Ratio, '"':', fixed=TRUE)
z"'$p287 <- vapply(parts, function(v) { x <- as.numeric(v); x[1] / sum(x) }, numeric(1))
stopifnot(nrow(z) == 36L, !anyNA(z[, c('"'Area','p287')]), all(table(z"'$p287) == 3L))
fits <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287''^2), data=z),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287''^2) + I(p287''^3), data=z),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df=4), data=z)
)
comparison <- data.frame(
  model=names(fits),
  n=vapply(fits,nobs,numeric(1)),
  AIC=vapply(fits,AIC,numeric(1)),
  adj_R2=vapply(fits,function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared,numeric(1))
)
print(comparison, row.names=FALSE, digits=12)
best <- fits[[which.min(comparison$AIC)]]
objective <- function(p) -as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(p287=p)))
opt <- optimize(objective, interval=range(z$p287), tol=.Machine$double.eps''^0.5)
cat(sprintf('"'range=[%.15f, %.15f]\\n', min(z"'$p287), max(z$p287)))
cat(sprintf('"'optimal_frequency=%.12f\\n', opt"'$minimum))
cat(sprintf('"'maximum_predicted_area=%.12f\\n', -opt"'$objective))
# Numerical local maximum check
h <- 1e-6
yp <- -objective(opt$minimum+h); y0 <- -objective(opt$minimum); ym <- -objective(opt$minimum-h)
stopifnot(y0 > yp, y0 > ym)
RS'
